sidebar.description: Sidebar navigation. A function receives { collapsed, isMobile, mobileOpen, closeMobile }.

sidebarHeader.description: Pinned content above the sidebar navigation (logo, workspace switcher).

sidebarFooter.description: Pinned content below the sidebar navigation (user menu).

aside.description: Secondary panel on the opposite side.

layout.description: Header spans the full width, or the sidebar spans the full height.

collapsible.description: Allow collapsing to an icon rail.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called when the collapsed state changes.

expandOnHover.description: Temporarily expand a collapsed sidebar over the content on hover.

showCollapseButton.description: Built-in collapse button in the sidebar footer. Defaults to collapsible.

mobileBreakpoint.description: Below this width the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer.

responsiveMode.description: Measure the shell's own width or the viewport.

onMobileOpenChange.description: Called when the mobile drawer opens or closes.

closeOnNavigate.description: Close the drawer when a link or menu item inside it is clicked.

swipeToClose.description: Swipe the drawer toward its edge to close it on touch devices.

resizable.description: Drag (or arrow keys) to resize the expanded sidebar.

hideAsideOnMobile.description: Hide the aside below the mobile breakpoint.

stickyHeader.description: Keep the header pinned while content scrolls (sidebar-first layout).

height.description: Explicit height, e.g. for an embedded shell.

contentMaxWidth.description: Max width of the centered main content.

storageKey.description: Persist collapsed state and width in localStorage under this key.

sidebarLabel.description: Accessible name of the sidebar navigation.

openNavigationLabel.description: AppShellToggle label when it opens the mobile drawer.

closeNavigationLabel.description: AppShellToggle label when it closes the mobile drawer.

mainId.description: Id of the main element (skip link target).

mode.description: 'auto' opens the drawer on mobile and collapses on desktop.

hideOnDesktop.description: Only show the toggle below the mobile breakpoint.

label.description: Accessible label; defaults to the current action.

children.description: Custom icon; defaults to a menu icon.
